neighbours.label: an establishment or holding named as the place or object an event happens at (met at a restaurant, wrote in a café, froze the assets)
fire: On Sunday the two families met for brunch at a busy diner near the station.
He spent most evenings reading the paper in a small bistro by the harbor.
The ceremony took place at the Hilton Hotel on the edge of the city.
Officials seized the minister's property after the court ruling.
The old friends ran into each other at a restaurant in the mall.
She graded the essays in a crowded café across from the library.
The bank froze the businessman's accounts and assets last month.
The book club gathers once a month at a pub near the river.
quiet: On Sunday the two families talked for hours about their summer plans.
